title: Object Video Tracking
description: An end-to-end deep learning pipeline for robust multi-object tracking on the MOT16 dataset-built for self-driving cars, intelligent surveillance, and live sports analytics.
detailedDescription: Object Video Tracking is a state-of-the-art system combining a fine-tuned Faster R-CNN (ResNet-50 FPN) for high-precision person detection with a Siamese network for consistent re-identification through occlusions. On-the-fly color jitter and Gaussian blur augmentations further improve robustness. The full pipeline is demonstrated in an interactive Colab notebook and output tracking video.
features: Fine-tuned Faster R-CNN (ResNet-50 FPN) achieving 87% accuracy, 99% precision, 93% F₁
Siamese network generating 256-D embeddings; contrastive loss ↓ 0.32 → 0.27
On-the-fly color jitter and Gaussian blur for augmentation
Interactive Colab demo for easy experimentation

title: FinGo
description: A personal finance app to manage bank accounts, set budgets, and track spending-with real-time dashboards and insights.
detailedDescription: FinGo is a real-time finance management app built with React, TypeScript, Vite, and Supabase. It provides an intuitive dashboard for connecting bank accounts, creating and allocating budgets, logging expenses, and visualizing spending trends-all synced live via Supabase.
features: Sign up, log in, and session management via Supabase Auth
Add, list, edit, and remove multiple bank accounts
Create budgets by category and track allocation progress
Log daily expenses and view spending trends
Real-time data syncing with Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth)
Mobile-first responsive UI using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui
